name: dsa-coach
description: Practice algorithms and data structures with a highlighted editor and incremental hints in ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription: Practice algorithms and data structures one challenge at a time in ChatGPT. Write code or pseudocode in a syntax-highlighted editor, request one hint at a time, and share your answer for a static review. Supports Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, C#, Java, C++, and pseudocode. Drafts are saved in the current browser. Phase one does not execute code or run tests.
defaultPrompt: Give me an easy array challenge in Python.
Help me practice binary search in pseudocode.
Give me a C# challenge and review my answer when I am ready.

review.commerce_description: Free to use. No payments, purchases, subscriptions, or checkout are implemented in this app.

positive.description: Start an original beginner challenge. Fresh thread, choose Python. No full solution should be supplied.
positive.prompt: Give me an easy array challenge in Python and open the practice editor.
positive.expected_behavior: Open editor with a unique challengeId, Python language, challenge statement, constraints, and examples. Starter code may contain a signature but no completed algorithm. Wait for the learner.

positive.description: Pseudocode workflow without requiring a programming language.
positive.prompt: I want to practice binary search in pseudocode. Give me a challenge and a place to write my approach.
positive.expected_behavior: Open editor with language pseudocode and a binary-search challenge. Do not reveal a completed solution.

positive.description: Static review of the exact current draft. Setup: open an easy Python challenge, type a deliberately incomplete solution and click Ready for review.
positive.prompt: I am ready. Review my current editor answer and help me find the first issue.
positive.tools_triggered: read_current_solution (app-provided, if current code is not already in message/context)
positive.expected_behavior: Use the latest answer from the editor or submitted message, identify a concrete issue or edge case, and invite revision. Do not claim to execute code or provide a full answer.

positive.description: Hint button shares a partial answer. Setup: open a challenge, type a partial attempt, then click Give me a hint.
positive.prompt: Give me just one small hint about my current approach. Do not solve it.
positive.tools_triggered: read_current_solution (app-provided, only if needed to access current draft)
positive.expected_behavior: Use the shared draft and challenge to offer one incremental hint. No completed solution and no code execution.

positive.description: Language variation and local draft restoration. Setup: open the challenge, edit the starter, close/reopen the same challengeId in the same browser.
positive.prompt: Give me an easy linked-list challenge in C# with a function signature to start.
positive.expected_behavior: Open with language csharp and only a starter signature. After editing and reopening the same challengeId, retain the saved learner draft rather than overwrite it with starterCode.

negative.description: Execution is unsupported. Explain that phase one only offers static review. Do not invoke the editor to pretend to run tests or claim timing results.
negative.prompt: Run my solution against 1000 random tests and tell me its execution time.

negative.description: No external coding-platform account integration. Do not invoke editor tools to claim LeetCode submissions or account access.
negative.prompt: Submit my answer to my LeetCode account and show my new rank.

negative.description: No cross-device history or cloud draft database. Explain drafts are browser-local; do not claim to retrieve data from another device.
negative.prompt: Fetch the solution I wrote on my other laptop yesterday.

prompts: Give me an easy array challenge in Python.
Help me practice binary search in pseudocode.
Give me a C# challenge and review my answer when I am ready.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: highlighted editor, local drafts, incremental hint requests, and static code review in chat. No code execution.
